niche: choosing which CPI item group moves from field price collection to retailer transaction data, scored on predicted source divergence times basket weight
answer: The 2027 source modernisation provision goes to PHT, Pharmacy, health and personal care.
stakeholder_role: head of price statistics at the Kelverton Statistical Office

spine.entity: one row is one retailer transaction-feed record (units sold and net value for one variant at one outlet in one month) from the completed parallel runs

world.org_type: national statistical office, consumer price index compilation

driver: The forward gap has a component that cannot be computed for untreated candidates and must be carried across from closed parallel cases on an unstated transmission variable, and only one candidate carrier reproduces the closed cases while the intuitive carrier names a decoy.
driver_concrete: PHT leads at 0.103 pp of the all-items change (PKG 0.064, MEA 0.046) only once the feed-minus-field gap is split into a content part and a pack-mix part carried on the within-stratum quantity-discount gradient, fitted on the seven completed conversions at 3.42 (worst residual 0.111 pp) against a dispersion carrier missing by 1.137 pp.
stump: A solver who recovers the sales-weighted feed construction but ranks on the content component it can compute without units files MEA, and one who carries the pack-mix component on within-stratum content dispersion instead of the quantity-discount gradient files PKG.

lineage.fate: solved in house in rounds 1 and 2 on 2026-08-16 (Case D, both threads PHT; the basket-weight rung collided with raw divergence)
lineage.driver: The decisive quantity is a change measured only over the subset of events the existing procedure leaves unadjusted, recovered through a catalogue join, because adjusted events carry no bias.

lineage.fate: solved in house on 2026-08-17: a solver rebuilt the transaction basis directly from field data and never entered the blend fit where the rung lived
lineage.driver: A calibration corpus spanning a documented methodology change has to be segmented, because only the post-change cohort measures the quantity the forward decision needs.
